Title: Osney Bridge towpath closure Oxford
Description: Towpath closed 150 yards upstream from bridge. Diversion via Abbey Road and Botley Road.

Title: Marsh Lock Footbridge closure Henley
Description: Footbridge closed for safety. 2.7-3 mile diversion via A4155 between Shiplake and Henley.

Title: Sandford Footbridge closure
Description: Unsafe footbridge north of Sandford Lock closed. Diversion via NCN5.

Title: Abingdon Weir walkway intermittent closure
Description: Corrosion damage. Closed intermittently during high water/high flows. Diverted via town centre.

Title: Temple Footbridge closure Hurley/Marlow
Description: Closed May 2023. Central span removed November 2025. Unlikely to reopen before 2028.

Title: Bridge 142 closure near Egham Runnymede
Description: Tree strike damage Feb 2024. Structural closure. Diversion via A308. Expected to remain closed until 2027.

Title: Bell Weir Lock diversion Runnymede
Description: Small diversion at Runnymede Pleasure Grounds for refurbishment works. Thames Path diverted around compound.

Title: Streatley-Goring towpath diversion eroding path
Description: 0.5 mile diversion due to eroding towpath. Unlikely to reopen until late 2026.

Title: Penton Hook Island closure diseased trees
Description: Island closed due to diseased ash trees. Thames Path unaffected but island access denied.

Title: Ten Foot Bridge closure Faringdon
Description: Structural safety concerns. Closed March 2024. No reopening date announced.

Title: Brentford Grand Union Canal left bank disruption
Description: Path blocked on left bank of Grand Union Canal between River Brent bridge and Marina. Redevelopment ongoing.
